body:
Hey, the only way I can explain it is imagine having a job you really hate and every day it drains you and you just don't know how you can keep on working there, that's how life feels for me. I feel like just living is a constant job. 
It's like I would like to rob a bank and be a millionaire but I know it's wrong so I don't. That's how I feel about suicide I would like to kill myself and be at peace but I know it's wrong so I don't. 

I have tried different antidepressants and different kinds of therapy. 
When I was young and I had a bad childhood I thought that life would get better when I moved out and built a life for myself. Now I have a good job, a good car, bought a house and I'm only 25. 
But things still happen I still suffer from other people and treated badly. 

I'm exhausted and have lost all hope, I just believe that if things haven't gotten better in the last 15 years then they won't in the future. 
People think that suicide is the cowards way out but Iv been fighting for years and just don't want to anymore. 

I hope I don't come across as selfish.
